borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Typography is TT Norms Pro (DoorDash's proprietary face, very close to a tightened Proxima Nova / SF Pro hybrid). Titles are set in weight 700 at 20-28pt — assertive, not elegant — and body copy sits at weight 400 with generous tracking that keeps restaurant names and delivery times readable at speed. The hierarchy is brutal and efficient: price in large bold numerals, restaurant name in 17-20pt semibold, meta-data (rating, fee, time) in 13pt regular gray. The color temperature is warm throughout: off-white (`#FFFFFF`) body, charcoal text (`#191919`), neutral cool grays for borders, and a small supporting palette of warm highlights (orange `#FF8000` for ratings, green `#008B4A` for $0 fee badges).

borders.description: Divider (`#E5E5E5`): Hairline dividers, card borders (where used), list row separators.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段

do: 建议：Use DoorDash Red ({#EB1700}) for every primary CTA — it's the "spend money" color。
建议：Photograph food at 16:9 with warm lighting; never use stock-flat food photos。
建议：Set titles in weight 700 — hierarchy is bold, not subtle。
建议：Keep the floating checkout button pinned bottom when cart > 0。
建议：Round primary CTAs to 28pt (pill shape); round cards to 16pt。
dont: 避免：use DoorDash Red for non-interactive elements — no red text, no red icons beyond the pin/logo。
避免：use small-title nav bars on top-level tabs — DoorDash uses large-title iOS style。
避免：understate price — always weight 700, never italicized。
避免：compose food cards without a photo — no placeholders, no gray blocks in production。
避免：use square food photos — 16:9 is the law。
